g.text: Six cases per panel; equal cases, speed conditions and participants. All five arms are reported. Pressure support is fixed parent rows 100:2100.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: ACC and gyro share one proper rotation per sensor; optical labels and time are unchanged. This tests coordinate sensitivity and does not measure true sensor remount.
